## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 399 captures during June 2024. This provides the activity total for the month and confirms that imaging was undertaken at the site throughout the reporting period. The recorded captures form the basis for the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

A total of 85 captures were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 21.3 per cent of all captures. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality during routine activity and identify any recurring issues that may affect the usability of images.

## Grading

There were 79 referable results during the month. The median lag for grading was 4 days. These results should be reviewed alongside the image quality information to support ongoing monitoring of the service.

The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues consistently will help maintain an appropriate operational record and support follow-up where required.
